product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out Video Wall TV Mount for Large Screen Displays Fits 85 to 120 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out Video Wall TV Mount for Large Screen Displays – Fits 85"–120" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out Video Wall TV Mount for Large Screen Displays is a commercial-grade solution engineered for very large, heavy video wall panels. Designed for professional AV installations, it allows individual displays to extend forward for service access and then retract into a precise, flush video wall alignment. Ideal for corporate lobbies, control rooms, broadcast environments, and public venues where clean presentation, structural strength, and long-term serviceability are critical.Scissor-style push-to-pop-out mechanism allows a single display to extend forward for cable access or servicing without disturbing adjacent panelsSupports flat panel displays from 85" to 120" with a maximum display weight of 308 lb (140 kg) per screenVESA compatible from 200×200 to 1200×600 mm for broad large-format display compatibilityWall distance range of 126 mm (5 in) retracted to 310 mm (12.2 in) fully extendedFlush video wall alignment when closed – locks display into fixed position for consistent depth across multi-panel installationsHeight and depth adjustment of 10 mm (0.39 in) each for precise panel-to-panel alignmentIndoor use only; professional AV installer required due to display size and weightSpring lock push-rail mechanism with locking safety screws for secure, stable long-term installation PUSH-TO-POP-OUT SERVICE ACCESSThe scissor-style push-to-pop-out mechanism allows a single display to extend outward from the wall for cable access or servicing. Once complete, the mechanism retracts smoothly, returning the display to its flush position without disturbing adjacent video wall panels. DESIGNED FOR LARGE FORMAT VIDEO WALLSDesigned for flat panel displays measuring 85" to 120", this mount supports a maximum display weight of 308 lb (140 kg) per screen – making it suitable for today's largest commercial LCD displays and LED-backlit panels. FLUSH VIDEO WALL ALIGNMENTWhen closed, the mount locks the display into a fixed, flush position relative to the wall. This ensures consistent depth and alignment across multi-panel video walls, helping minimize visible gaps and uneven screen planes for a seamless viewing experience. WIDE VESA COMPATIBILITYCompatible with a broad range of VESA mounting patterns from 200×200 mm up to 1200×600 mm, supporting most large-format professional displays without additional adapters. Includes VESA600 extension bars and VESA1200 brackets. PROFESSIONAL INDOOR INSTALLATIONIntended for indoor use only and requires professional AV installation. The installation surface must support at least five times the combined weight of the display and mounting hardware. Team lifting or mechanical assistance is strongly recommended for displays of this size and weight. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Push-to-pop-out video wall mounting assembly• Left and right display mounting brackets• VESA600 extension bars (2 pairs)• VESA1200 brackets (1 pair)• Commercial-grade installation hardware• Printed installation manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
